questions: How long have your cough and dyspnea been going on (in days/weeks/months), and did they start suddenly or gradually?
Have you noticed any blood in your sputum (coughing up blood) or worsening wheeze/stridor?
Have you had any fever or night sweats recently?
Have you had any fever (measured or not) or chills in the last few weeks?
Have you noticed any weight loss amount (e.g., pounds/kg) and have you had coughing up mucus that is yellow/green, or coughing up blood?
Have you had any recent chest pain—especially pleuritic pain—or leg swelling/pain that could suggest a blood clot (pulmonary embolism)?
Have you experienced any coughing up blood (even small streaks) at any point, and if so, how much and how often?
Have you had a recent chest X-ray or CT scan, and what were the results (or have you not had imaging yet)?
Have you had any known exposure to someone with tuberculosis (TB) or lived/traveled in a high-TB area in the past 2 years?
Have you had recent results from a chest X-ray or CT scan, and if so what did they show (e.g., a mass, pneumonia, or lung nodules)?
answers: My cough and shortness of breath have been going on for **a few weeks**. They started **gradually**, and they’ve been getting worse since then.
I **haven’t noticed blood** in my sputum. I also haven’t had **wheezing or stridor** that I’m aware of.
I’m not sure about fever, but I **do have night sweats** recently.
I may have had some **chills**, but I can’t say for sure about a fever—if it was measured, I don’t remember it.
I’ve had **unintentional weight loss**—I don’t know the exact amount in pounds/kg. And my cough is with **mucus**, but I’m not sure if it’s yellow/green; I also **haven’t coughed up blood**.
I haven’t had **chest pain** like that. I also **don’t have leg swelling or leg pain**.
No, I **haven’t coughed up blood** at any point, even small streaks.
I **haven’t had** a chest X-ray or CT scan yet, so I don’t know the results.
I **don’t know** of any exposure to someone with TB, and I **haven’t traveled** to a high-TB area in the past 2 years.
No—**I don’t have any recent chest X-ray or CT results yet**.
